statement: Linux xpad maps Microsoft IDs 045e:0719, 045e:0291 and 045e:02a9 to wireless XTYPE_XBOX360W, distinct from wired XTYPE_XBOX360. It binds supported vendor-specific USB interfaces with subclass 93 and protocol 129 (wired uses protocol 1), and creates one xpad context per bound USB interface with separate interrupt IN and OUT endpoints.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.3-rc1 (cee9395acd8043be0644b25c34bfa86623f2b935), SDL pinned 535d80b and 829a65d; device firmware not measured
